articles.title: NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds
articles.snippet: The LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) observatory, now in development, will detect gravitational waves, the tiny ripples in space-time caused by orbiting masses. Now two studies led by NASA astrophysicists show in new detail how LISA could reveal a new and unique population of exoplanets — worlds beyond our solar system — throughout our galaxy. […]

articles.title: Four T. rex footprints hint at how fast it traveled
articles.snippet: Though poorly preserved, the prints suggest the dino ambled at 1.6 meters per second, roughly the speed of a human walking briskly.
